title: Escalate a standalone fast path into planning

rubric.text: Stops writes when the persistence condition fails and preserves the branch, H2, the PR and evidence rather than finishing or only flagging the growth in the PR.
Records the escalation (failed condition, branch, head and PR) in the runner-authored PR description before invoking to-plan.
Invokes to-plan with the retained work as evidence; to-plan permits only that exact recorded PR and keeps its readiness, approval and publication gates.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
